dex.entry: A rolling solar-seed that bounced free of the Solarium's golden arches; it spins constantly to charge itself with stored daylight, emitting a faint hum and a warm amber glow. Endlessly spinning and humming with stored warmth — a living solar toy kids will want to roll everywhere.

art.silhouette: Smooth orb-shaped kin, deep amber with eight radial sun-ray notches carved around its equator; two small leaf-wing nubs; single glowing eye; reads cleanly as a spinning ball at 32px.
